comment: PuerTS CS.* binding surface of the embedded runtime bundle (Resources/pie/core.bytes). These calls are invisible to Unity's static linker, so every type listed here MUST stay preserved in Runtime/link.xml or IL2CPP players fail at runtime (dogfood P1: 'CS.System.IO.File.Copy is not a function'). Gate: npm run check:unity-binding-surface re-scans the built bundle; any CS.* chain not covered here fails the check — add the type to requiredTypes AND preserve it in link.xml in the same commit.

requiredTypes.name: System.Convert
requiredTypes.usedBy: base64 encode for bridge file reads (image payloads)

requiredTypes.name: System.Environment
requiredTypes.usedBy: home folder resolution for session/config paths

requiredTypes.name: Pie.PieFileBridge
requiredTypes.usedBy: native file bridge (bounded reads, base64 fallback)

requiredTypes.name: Pie.PieBridge
requiredTypes.usedBy: LoadResourceText for the lazy TypeScript compiler (optional-chained probe)

optionalProbes.name: AgentBridge
optionalProbes.usedBy: packages/platform http.ts probes CS.AgentBridge?.HttpPostAsyncStart for a legacy host bridge; absent by design (optional chaining) and falls back to UnityWebRequest. Do NOT add to link.xml.

engineRootedComment: UnityEngine/UnityEditor types are rooted by the package's own C# (Pie.Runtime references them directly) and by Unity's engine stripping rules; they do not need link.xml entries. If a host player ever strips one anyway, move that specific type into requiredTypes with its UnityEngine.*Module assembly.
proactivePreservesComment: link.xml MAY preserve more than this manifest (e.g. System.Text.*) as cheap insurance for dynamic access; extra preserves are reported as informational, not failures.
